summary: Iteration 29: Browse Pros Feature Testing - All 16 features tested. Fixed 2 bugs: (1) pipeline.py using wrong field name 'employer_id' instead of 'poster_id', (2) HiringPipelinePage.jsx skills rendering error for object-type skills. All backend tests pass (14/14), frontend Browse Pros flow working correctly.

fixed.issue: Returned 0 candidates because query used 'employer_id' instead of 'poster_id'
fixed.fix: Changed db.jobs.find({'employer_id': ...}) to db.jobs.find({'poster_id': ...}) in routes/pipeline.py lines 43 and 174

fixed.issue: React error 'Objects are not valid as a React child' when skills array contains objects with {skill, confidence} keys
fixed.fix: Updated skills rendering to handle both string and object types: typeof s === 'string' ? s : s?.skill || s?.name || ''
